title: 第13章 一场杀戮第14章 先收一件宝物
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
再次答应出任西凤商盟的供奉，是李凡深思熟虑过的。
修仙，资源非常重要。
而如今的李凡，人际关系方面，十分有限。
至于西凤商盟，可以说是一棵大树，最起码，可以提供李凡一些修炼资源。
不过，天下没有免费的午餐，李凡必须给西凤商盟解决一些麻烦。
权衡利弊，李凡还是选择继续当这个供奉一职。
李凡答应下来，三小姐显得十分高兴，立刻带李凡来到店铺后院。
这里有足足二十多个箱子，都是新运来的货物。
这也看出西凤商盟对这个新开辟的店铺，十分重视。
“全部打开！”
三小姐大手一挥。
几个伙计，手脚十分利索，片刻的功夫，将所有货物都摆放出来。
琳琅满目！
法器，符咒，炼器材料，功法，阵法，应有尽有。
当然，大部分都是普通货色，以李凡现在的眼界，自然看不上。
“嗯，李供奉，这最后一个箱子，是最珍贵的！”
三小姐亲自把最后一个箱子打开。
一股灵气，扑面而来。
李凡露出感兴趣的眼神。
十个锦盒，三小姐亲自打开。

五件法器，三张符咒，一部功法，还有一个阵法。
五件法器，四件是中品法器，对李凡来说，意义不大，可有可无。
可是，最后一件法器，李凡却是眼前一亮。
三小姐察言观色的本领，自然不可多让，立刻解释，“李供奉，这是一件网状上品法器，只是可惜，法器破坏严重，修复难度很大！”
网状法器，众所周知，是最难缠的一种法器。
尤其是如今的这个网状法器还是上品法器。
心中已经兴趣盎然，但李凡的表情尽量平淡一些。
三张符咒，可是了不起，全部是中级符咒。
对于符咒，李凡也十分感兴趣，不要忘了，上次偷袭灭杀赤鼻仙人，那张低级符咒天雷符可是起到关键作用。
至于功法，只是一种高级的轻身术，已经有九转登天步的李凡，自然不感兴趣。
至于阵法，名为五行离水阵。
这是一种水系法阵，偏向于防御。
阵法，在修仙界诸多学识中，是最深奥的。
尤其是在散修里，能拥有一套阵法，是十分不易的。
“网状法器，三张符咒，还有阵法，我都要了！
多出的两个宝物，我可以付钱！
还有，我需要一个储物戒指，一个灵兽袋。”
李凡说道。
“看来，李供奉，似乎有什么重要的事情，才会如此大规模采购。”
content_en:
Li Fan had thought carefully about agreeing to serve as the worshiper of the Xifeng Merchant Alliance again.
In cultivating immortality, resources are very important.
But today Li Fan's interpersonal relationships are very limited.
As for the Xifeng Merchant Alliance, it can be said to be a big tree. At the very least, it can provide Li Fan with some training resources.
However, there is no free lunch in the world, and Li Fan must solve some problems for the Xifeng Merchant Alliance.
After weighing the pros and cons, Li Fan chose to continue his position as a worshipper.
Li Fan agreed, and the third lady seemed very happy and immediately took Li Fan to the backyard of the store.
There are more than twenty boxes here, all of which are newly shipped goods.
This also shows that the Xifeng Merchant Alliance attaches great importance to this newly opened store.
"Open them all!"
The third lady waved her hand.
The few guys were very nimble with their hands and feet, and in just a moment, they laid out all the goods.
A dazzling array of items!
Magical weapons, spells, weapon refining materials, exercises, formations, everything is available.
Of course, most of them are ordinary goods. With Li Fan's current vision, he naturally looks down on them.
"Well, Li Gongfeng, this last box is the most precious!"
The third lady opened the last box herself.
A burst of spiritual energy rushed to his face.
Li Fan showed interest.
The third lady opened ten brocade boxes in person.
Five magic weapons, three spells, one skill, and one formation.
There are five magical artifacts, four of which are medium-grade magical artifacts. To Li Fan, they are of little significance and are dispensable.
However, Li Fan's eyes lit up when it came to the last magical weapon.
The third lady's ability to observe people's emotions was naturally not compromised, so she immediately explained, "Li Gongfeng, this is a mesh-shaped high-grade magic weapon. It's a pity that the magic weapon is seriously damaged and it is very difficult to repair!"
As we all know, the mesh magic weapon is the most difficult type of magic weapon.
Especially today's mesh-shaped magic weapon is still a top-grade magic weapon.
He was already very interested, but Li Fan's expression was as calm as possible.
The three spells are amazing, all of them are intermediate spells.
Li Fan is also very interested in talismans. Don't forget that the low-level talisman Sky Thunder Talisman played a key role in the last sneak attack to kill the Red-Nosed Immortal.
As for the technique, it was just an advanced light-body technique. Li Fan, who had already reached the ninth rank of Heavenly Step, was naturally not interested.
As for the formation, it is called the Five Elements Leaving Water Formation.
This is a water-based magic circle, biased towards defense.
Formation is the most profound among the many knowledges in the world of immortality.
Especially among casual cultivators, it is very difficult to have a set of formations.
"I want the mesh magic weapon, the three spells, and the formation!
I can pay for the two extra treasures!
Also, I need a storage ring and a spirit animal bag. "
Li Fan said.
"It seems that Li Gongfeng has something important to do to make such a large-scale purchase."
